data.description:
Seed intent: Create 3 weapon power-ups that, when collected, change the weapon the ship uses. Power-ups have no timer — active until another weapon power-up is collected. The ship's starting weapon is a simple single-shot cannon firing in the direction of travel. The power-ups add additional shot patterns. A 4th power-up returns the ship to the starting weapon. Create a Gym scene in which each power-up spawns in round-robin fashion. Power-ups stay on screen 7 seconds. On spawn they grow from nothing to full size; on despawn they shrink to nothing. They are collectible at 3% of full size or larger. Priority: medium (operator-specified).
